predeclared_rule: Per exon, select three significant negative and three significant positive variants at padj < 0.1, plus four matched nonsignificant controls.

failure.message: BRAF_e14: fewer than three significant negative variants
failure.reason: BRAF_e14 has zero significant negative experimental effects, so the sign-balanced rule cannot produce the frozen 50-variant set.

leakage_statement: The attempt and feasibility audit read only the frozen experimental allowlist and exact VCF alleles. No AlphaGenome or comparator predictor column was inspected or used, and no model inference ran.
disposition: Preserve v1 unchanged. Define the changed selection rule as v2 rather than replacing an exon or silently rewriting v1.
